wg_weighted-push-up.hands: Hands under your shoulders, a bit wider.
wg_weighted-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
wg_weighted-push-up.back: Body straight so the weight stays put.
wg_weighted-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_weighted-push-up.mistake: Adding weight before normal push-ups feel easy.

steps: Stand side-on to a low cable, handle in the far hand.
Lift your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
wg_cable-lateral-raise.hands: Palm faces down at the top.
wg_cable-lateral-raise.back: Stand tall; do not lean away.

steps: Hold light dumbbells and lean forward from your hips.
Let the dumbbells hang under your chest.
Lift your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.
wg_rear-delt-fly.back: Back flat, nearly level with the floor.
wg_rear-delt-fly.mistake: Swinging the weights up with your body.

steps: Stand over the T-bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lean forward with a flat back.
Pull the handles to your chest.
Lower slowly.
wg_t-bar-row.arms: Elbows stay close to your body.

steps: Lie chest-down on the pad.
Hold the handles with arms straight.
Pull the handles back toward your ribs.
Return slowly.
wg_chest-supported-row.legs: Feet on the floor or footrest.
wg_chest-supported-row.mistake: Lifting your chest off the pad.

steps: Sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles with arms straight.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
wg_machine-row.back: Sit tall; chest on the pad.
wg_machine-row.mistake: Leaning back to pull the weight.

steps: Sit at the machine with your thighs under the pad.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly.
wg_lat-pulldown.arms: Pull your elbows down to your sides.
wg_lat-pulldown.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down.

steps: Kneel or stand on the machine's pad and grab the handles.
Hang with your arms straight.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles.
Lower slowly.
wg_assisted-pull-up.hands: Palms face away, a bit wider than shoulders.
wg_assisted-pull-up.arms: Pull your elbows down to your ribs.
wg_assisted-pull-up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.
wg_assisted-pull-up.mistake: Not going all the way down.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push up and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep walking, switching legs.
wg_walking-lunge.hands: Dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
wg_walking-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
wg_walking-lunge.mistake: Steps too short, so the knee goes past the toes.

steps: Set up in the leg curl machine with the pad above your heels.
Hold the handles.
Curl your heels toward your bottom.
Return slowly.
wg_leg-curl.legs: Knees line up with the pivot.
wg_leg-curl.back: Hips stay down on the pad.

steps: Kneel on the pad and grip the dip handles.
Push up until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up.
wg_assisted-dip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_assisted-dip.mistake: Going so low your shoulders hurt.

steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly. Switch arms after your set.
wg_landmine-press.hands: Hold the end of the bar, wrist straight.
wg_landmine-press.arms: Elbow starts tucked in front of your body.
wg_landmine-press.back: Stand tall; do not lean back.

steps: Wear a dip belt with a weight attached.
Hold the dip bars and lift yourself up.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up.
wg_weighted-dip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_weighted-dip.mistake: Adding weight before bodyweight dips feel easy.

steps: Sit in the machine with the pads against your arms.
Lift your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
wg_machine-lateral-raise.arms: Push with your elbows against the pads.

steps: Hold light dumbbells and lean forward from your hips.
Let them hang under your shoulders.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.
wg_bent-over-rear-delt-raise.mistake: Using momentum to swing the weights.

steps: Stand over a barbell and lean forward until your back is flat.
Grip the bar a bit wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar from the floor to your lower chest.
Lower it back to the floor each rep.
wg_pendlay-row.back: Back flat and level with the floor.

steps: Stand side-on to the end of a landmine bar.
Lean forward and grip the bar end with one hand.
Pull it up toward your hip.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
wg_meadows-row.hands: Overhand grip on the thick end of the bar.

steps: Hang from parallel handles, palms facing each other.
Pull your shoulders down.
Pull up until your chin is over the handles.
Lower slowly.
wg_neutral-grip-pull-up.arms: Elbows pull down toward your ribs.
wg_neutral-grip-pull-up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.
wg_neutral-grip-pull-up.mistake: Kicking your legs to get up.

steps: Kneel on the assist pad and grab the bar, palms facing you.
Hang with your arms straight.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly.
wg_assisted-chin-up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.

steps: Wear a dip belt with a weight, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hang from the bar, palms facing you.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly.
wg_weighted-chin-up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.
wg_weighted-chin-up.mistake: Adding weight before bodyweight chin-ups feel easy.

steps: Clip the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat.
Push up through your feet.
wg_belt-squat.hands: Hold the handles lightly for balance.
wg_belt-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand in a long stride, a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push up through your front heel.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
wg_split-squat.legs: Front knee over your ankle; feet stay in place.
wg_split-squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, with a dumbbell on your hips.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your bottom at the top.
Lower slowly.
wg_dumbbell-glute-bridge.hands: Hold the dumbbell steady on your hips.
wg_dumbbell-glute-bridge.back: Do not arch at the top.

steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench, dumbbell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat.
Push through your heels to lift your hips level.
Lower slowly.
wg_dumbbell-hip-thrust.hands: Hold the dumbbell on your hips.
wg_dumbbell-hip-thrust.legs: Shins straight up and down at the top.
wg_dumbbell-hip-thrust.back: Upper back on the bench; ribs down.
wg_dumbbell-hip-thrust.mistake: Arching your back at the top.

steps: Sit against a bench with the padded Smith bar over your hips.
Plant your feet flat.
Push up through your heels until your hips are level.
Lower slowly.
wg_smith-machine-hip-thrust.hands: Hold the bar to keep it steady.
wg_smith-machine-hip-thrust.legs: Shins straight up and down at the top.
wg_smith-machine-hip-thrust.mistake: Arching your back at the top.

steps: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the kettlebell down your legs.
Stand back up by pushing your hips forward.
wg_kettlebell-romanian-deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Set up in the machine with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles.
Push your leg back and up.
Return slowly. Switch legs after your set.
wg_machine-glute-kickback.back: Do not arch your lower back.
wg_machine-glute-kickback.mistake: Arching your back to push higher.

steps: Attach a cuff to your outside ankle at a low cable.
Stand side-on and hold the machine.
Lift that leg out to the side.
Return slowly. Switch legs after your set.
wg_cable-standing-hip-abduction.legs: Working leg straight; toes point forward.
wg_cable-standing-hip-abduction.mistake: Leaning your body to lift higher.

steps: Put the Smith bar across your upper back.
Step one foot back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to step back. Switch legs.
wg_smith-machine-reverse-lunge.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
wg_smith-machine-reverse-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Put the Smith bar across your upper back.
Stand in a long stride.
Lower your back knee straight down.
Push up through your front heel. Switch legs after your set.
wg_smith-machine-split-squat.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
wg_smith-machine-split-squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Stand with your heels on a small plate or wedge.
Hold a dumbbell upright at your chest.
Sit straight down into a deep squat.
Push up through your feet.
wg_heel-elevated-goblet-squat.hands: Cup the dumbbell at your chest.
wg_heel-elevated-goblet-squat.legs: Knees travel forward over your toes.
wg_heel-elevated-goblet-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand with feet wide, toes out.
Hold one dumbbell between your legs with both hands.
Bend your knees and hips to lower it toward the floor.
Stand back up tall.
wg_dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.hands: Both hands on the dumbbell handle.
wg_dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.legs: Knees push out over your toes.
wg_dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
wg_dumbbell-sumo-deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back at the bottom.

steps: Put your front foot on a low step, holding dumbbells.
Step the back foot behind you into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push up through your front heel. Switch legs after your set.
wg_front-foot-elevated-split-squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
wg_front-foot-elevated-split-squat.mistake: Using a step that is too high.

steps: Stand on a low step holding dumbbells.
Step one foot back off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to step back up. Switch legs.
wg_deficit-reverse-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Take a big step out to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back.
Push back to the middle. Switch sides.
wg_dumbbell-lateral-lunge.hands: Hold the dumbbell at your chest.
wg_dumbbell-lateral-lunge.legs: Bent knee follows your toes; other leg straight.
wg_dumbbell-lateral-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push back.
wg_dumbbell-lateral-lunge.mistake: Letting the bent knee cave in.

steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other.
Lower both knees.
Push up and return. Switch sides.
wg_dumbbell-curtsy-lunge.legs: Front knee stays over your foot.
wg_dumbbell-curtsy-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat.
Push up through your feet.
wg_landmine-squat.hands: Hold the bar end with both hands at your chest.
wg_landmine-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand over the end of a landmine bar, holding it with both hands.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bar.
Stand back up by pushing your hips forward.
wg_landmine-romanian-deadlift.hands: Both hands around the bar end.
wg_landmine-romanian-deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Stand with feet a bit wider than hips, kettlebell in front.
Hinge at your hips and swing it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it swing back down and repeat.
wg_kettlebell-swing.hands: Both hands on the handle, firm grip.
wg_kettlebell-swing.arms: Arms stay straight and loose; your hips do the work.
wg_kettlebell-swing.breathe: Breathe out as the bell swings up.
wg_kettlebell-swing.mistake: Squatting and lifting with your arms.

steps: Set up on a back extension bench, feet turned out.
Round your upper back slightly.
Lower your body by bending at the hips.
Squeeze your bottom to lift back up.
wg_glute-focused-back-extension.back: Stop when your body is straight; do not over-arch.
wg_glute-focused-back-extension.mistake: Lifting with your lower back instead of your bottom.

steps: Stand with your back against a wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide down.
Stop when your thighs are about level with the floor.
Hold still.
wg_wall-sit.hands: Hands on your thighs or by your sides, not pushing.
wg_wall-sit.back: Whole back flat against the wall.

steps: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back.
Keep your upper arms still.
wg_single-dumbbell-skullcrusher.hands: Both hands cup one end of the dumbbell.
wg_single-dumbbell-skullcrusher.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you lift.

steps: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm down.
Hold a light dumbbell with your wrist past your knee.
Lift the back of your hand up.
Lower slowly. Switch hands after your set.
wg_wrist-extension.arms: Forearm stays flat on your thigh.
wg_wrist-extension.mistake: Using a weight that is too heavy.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a moment.
Bring them back and switch sides.
wg_bird-dog.arms: Reaching arm straight, level with your body.
wg_bird-dog.legs: Knees under your hips; back leg straight.
wg_bird-dog.back: Back flat like a table; hips stay level.
wg_bird-dog.mistake: Lifting the leg too high and arching.

steps: Kneel on one knee side-on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press your arms straight out.
Hold, then bring it back.
wg_half-kneeling-pallof-press.mistake: Letting the cable turn your body.

steps: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with arms straight in front.
Hold still and do not let the cable turn you.
Switch sides.
wg_cable-pallof-hold.arms: Arms straight in front of your chest.

steps: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Lift your knees up toward your chest.
Lower them slowly.
Keep your body from swinging.
wg_hanging-knee-raise.back: Curl your hips slightly at the top.
wg_hanging-knee-raise.mistake: Swinging to get the knees up.

steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked.
Cross your arms on your chest.
Sit up toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
wg_decline-sit-up.breathe: Breathe out as you sit up.

steps: Sit with knees bent, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Lean back a little.
Turn your shoulders to one side.
Turn to the other side.
wg_weighted-russian-twist.hands: Hold the dumbbell with both hands.
wg_weighted-russian-twist.legs: Feet on the floor or lifted.

steps: Warm up with a few easy lengths.
Swim at a steady pace you can keep.
Rest at the wall when you need to.
Finish with an easy length or two.
wg_swimming.legs: Kick from your hips, not your knees.
wg_swimming.back: Body long and flat in the water.
wg_swimming.breathe: Breathe out underwater, in when you turn your head.

steps: Set the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom.
Push and pull the handles while you pedal.
Go easy to warm up, then work harder.
Ease off at the end.
wg_assault-bike.arms: Push and pull with your arms.
wg_assault-bike.mistake: Starting too fast and fading early.

steps: Stand facing the SkiErg and grab both handles up high.
Pull the handles down while bending at your hips and knees.
Finish with your hands by your thighs.
Stand back up and reach high again.
wg_skierg.arms: Arms pull down close to your body.
wg_skierg.legs: Knees bend a little each pull.
wg_skierg.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down.

steps: Wear good shoes and bring water.
Start slowly on the trail.
Take shorter steps going uphill and downhill.
Keep a pace you can talk at.
wg_hiking.arms: Swing your arms; use poles if you have them.
wg_hiking.back: Stand tall; lean slightly into hills.

steps: Start walking slowly on the treadmill.
Raise the incline a step at a time.
Walk at a brisk pace you can keep.
Lower the incline and slow down at the end.
wg_treadmill-incline-walk.back: Walk tall; do not lean forward.

steps: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body is straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up.
wg_knee-push-up.hands: Hands under your shoulders, fingers forward.
wg_knee-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
wg_knee-push-up.legs: Knees on a soft mat, feet can lift.
wg_knee-push-up.back: Straight line from head to knees; do not bend at hips.
wg_knee-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_knee-push-up.mistake: Sticking your bottom up in the air.

steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in.
Lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor.
Push back up.
wg_pike-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back, not out wide.
wg_pike-push-up.legs: Legs as straight as is comfy.
wg_pike-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_pike-push-up.mistake: Letting your hips drop so it becomes a normal push-up.

steps: Put your feet on a bench and hands on the floor.
Walk your hands back until your hips are high above them.
Lower your head toward the floor.
Push back up.
wg_feet-elevated-pike-push-up.legs: Feet on the bench, knees straight or slightly bent.
wg_feet-elevated-pike-push-up.back: Hips stay stacked above your shoulders.
wg_feet-elevated-pike-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_feet-elevated-pike-push-up.mistake: Trying this before regular pike push-ups feel easy.

steps: Start in a push-up with hands very wide.
Lower your body toward one hand, bending that arm.
Keep the other arm straight out to the side.
Push back up and switch sides.
wg_archer-push-up.hands: Hands much wider than your shoulders.
wg_archer-push-up.arms: One arm bends; the other stays straight.
wg_archer-push-up.legs: Legs straight, feet a bit apart.
wg_archer-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Start in a wide push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Shift your body across to one hand, then the other.
Push back up.
wg_typewriter-push-up.arms: Bend one arm while the other straightens.
wg_typewriter-push-up.back: Body stays low and straight as you shift.

steps: Start with hips high in an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down near the floor.
Push up into a gentle back bend, looking forward.
Push your hips back up to the start.
wg_hindu-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back close to your body.
wg_hindu-push-up.back: Move smoothly from high hips to a gentle arch.
wg_hindu-push-up.breathe: Breathe out as you swoop through.
wg_hindu-push-up.mistake: Rushing so the movement gets jerky.

steps: Start in a push-up position, arms straight.
Let your chest sink so your shoulder blades come together.
Push the floor away so your upper back rounds a little.
Repeat slowly.
wg_scapular-push-up.arms: Arms stay straight the whole time.
wg_scapular-push-up.back: Body straight; only your shoulder blades move.
wg_scapular-push-up.breathe: Breathe out as you push away.

steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Put it down and tap with the other hand.
Add a push-up between taps if you like.
wg_push-up-shoulder-tap.back: Keep your hips still and level.
wg_push-up-shoulder-tap.mistake: Rocking your hips side to side.

steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall.
Put your hands flat on the wall at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
wg_wall-push-up.hands: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders, fingers up.
wg_wall-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
wg_wall-push-up.legs: Feet together, on your toes as you lean.
wg_wall-push-up.back: Body straight from head to heels.
wg_wall-push-up.breathe: Breathe in as you lean in, out as you push.
wg_wall-push-up.mistake: Bending at the hips instead of keeping straight.

steps: Start in a push-up with your feet against a wall.
Walk your feet up the wall as you walk your hands back.
Go only as high as you can control.
Walk back down slowly.
wg_wall-walk.legs: Legs straight as you walk up.
wg_wall-walk.back: Squeeze your belly so your back stays straight.
wg_wall-walk.breathe: Breathe steadily; do not hold it.
wg_wall-walk.mistake: Going higher than you can safely control.

steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on a wall.
Lower your head slowly toward the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Come down carefully.
wg_wall-handstand-push-up.arms: Elbows bend back, not out wide.
wg_wall-handstand-push-up.back: Squeeze your belly; avoid a big arch.
wg_wall-handstand-push-up.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.
wg_wall-handstand-push-up.mistake: Trying this before you can hold a wall handstand.

steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and grip the front edge.
Slide your bottom off the seat.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up.
wg_chair-dip.hands: Fingers point forward, hands beside your hips.
wg_chair-dip.legs: Knees bent, feet flat; straighter legs make it harder.
wg_chair-dip.back: Keep your back close to the chair.
wg_chair-dip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
wg_chair-dip.mistake: Using a chair that rolls or slides.

steps: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the doorway.
Lower back slowly.
wg_doorway-row.hands: Grip the frame firmly at chest height.
wg_doorway-row.arms: Elbows pull back close to your sides.
wg_doorway-row.legs: Feet close to the door; walk them in to make it harder.
wg_doorway-row.back: Body straight from head to heels.
wg_doorway-row.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Loop a towel around a sturdy post or door handle.
Hold both ends and lean back, arms straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Lower back slowly.
wg_towel-row.arms: Elbows pull back by your sides.
wg_towel-row.mistake: Using something that can move or come loose.

steps: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y shape.
Lift your arms off the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly.
wg_prone-y-raise.hands: Thumbs point up toward the ceiling.
wg_prone-y-raise.arms: Arms straight in a wide Y.
wg_prone-y-raise.back: Forehead down; lift with your upper back, not your neck.
wg_prone-y-raise.mistake: Lifting your head and straining your neck.

steps: Lie face down with your arms straight out to the sides.
Lift your arms off the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
wg_prone-t-raise.back: Forehead down; keep your neck long.

steps: Lie face down with your arms straight in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold still.
Lower slowly.
wg_superman-hold.back: Lift gently; look at the floor.

steps: Lie face down, arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your arms just off the floor.
Sweep them out and up over your head.
Sweep them back to your sides.
wg_reverse-snow-angel.arms: Arms straight, hovering just off the floor.
wg_reverse-snow-angel.mistake: Letting your arms drop to the floor.

steps: Grab a pull-up bar with both hands.
Lift your feet and hang with straight arms.
Relax your body and hold.
Step down carefully.
wg_dead-hang.back: Body still; let it stretch long.
wg_dead-hang.mistake: Dropping off suddenly instead of stepping down.

steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold that position.
Step down carefully.
Use a box to get your chin over the bar.
Hold the top position.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can.
Step back onto the box and repeat.
Stand under the bar, side-on, hands one in front of the other.
Pull up, moving your head to one side of the bar.
Lower slowly.
Next rep, go to the other side.
wg_commando-pull-up.hands: Hands close together, palms facing each other.
wg_commando-pull-up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.

steps: Hang from the bar.
Lift your legs straight out in front, making an L.
Pull up while holding your legs up.
Lower slowly.
wg_l-sit-pull-up.legs: Legs straight and level with your hips.

steps: Hang two towels over a pull-up bar.
Grip one towel in each hand.
Pull up as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
wg_towel-pull-up.mistake: Losing your grip; build up slowly.

steps: Stand on one leg with the other leg out in front.
Reach your arms forward.
Squat down slowly on one leg.
Push back up. Switch legs.
wg_pistol-squat.legs: Standing knee follows your toes; heel stays down.
wg_pistol-squat.back: Chest up as much as you can.
wg_pistol-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Hold a doorframe, pole or strap.
Stand on one leg with the other out in front.
Squat down on one leg, using your hands for help.
Push back up. Switch legs.
wg_assisted-pistol-squat.hands: Hold the support just enough to balance.
wg_assisted-pistol-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand on one leg and hold the other foot behind you.
Bend your standing knee to lower your back knee to the floor.
Touch lightly, then stand back up.
Switch legs.
wg_shrimp-squat.hands: One hand holds your back foot; the other reaches forward.
wg_shrimp-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.
wg_shrimp-squat.mistake: Dropping down hard onto the knee.

steps: Stand with your feet very wide.
Shift your weight and squat down over one leg.
Keep the other leg straight, toes up.
Push back up and switch sides.
wg_cossack-squat.hands: Hands together in front for balance.
wg_cossack-squat.legs: Bent knee follows your toes; heel down.
wg_cossack-squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
wg_cossack-squat.mistake: Lifting the heel of the bent leg.

steps: Hold a support and stand on your toes.
Lean back as you bend your knees forward.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push back up.
wg_sissy-squat.legs: Knees go forward; heels stay lifted.
wg_sissy-squat.back: Body straight from knees to head.
wg_sissy-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.
wg_sissy-squat.mistake: Going lower than your knees can handle.

steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push back to standing. Switch legs.
wg_forward-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push back.
wg_forward-lunge.mistake: Letting the front knee wobble in.

steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Take a big step out to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back.
Push back to the middle. Switch sides.
wg_lateral-lunge.legs: Bent knee follows your toes; other leg straight.
wg_lateral-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push back.
wg_lateral-lunge.mistake: Letting the bent knee cave inward.

steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot behind and across the other.
Lower both knees.
Push back up. Switch sides.
wg_curtsy-lunge.legs: Front knee stays over your foot.
wg_curtsy-lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Stand on one leg with the other bent behind you.
Reach your arms forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push back up. Switch legs.
wg_skater-squat.back: Lean slightly forward with a flat back.
wg_skater-squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand on a step on one leg.
Slowly bend that knee and lower the other heel toward the floor.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push back up. Switch legs.
wg_step-down.hands: Hands on your hips or a wall.
wg_step-down.legs: Standing knee stays in line with your toes.
wg_step-down.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.
wg_step-down.mistake: Dropping fast instead of lowering slowly.

steps: Stand tall, holding a desk, wall or chair for balance.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
wg_calf-raise.hands: Rest your hands lightly on the desk or wall.
wg_calf-raise.mistake: Bouncing quickly instead of moving slowly.

steps: Stand on one foot, holding a wall for balance.
Rise up onto your toes.
Lower slowly.
Switch feet.
wg_single-leg-calf-raise.mistake: Rolling onto the outside of your foot.

steps: Lie on your back and lift your hips into a bridge.
Lift one foot a little off the floor.
Put it down and lift the other.
Keep your hips high and level.
wg_glute-bridge-march.legs: Lift each knee toward your chest.
wg_glute-bridge-march.back: Hips stay level; do not let them drop.
wg_glute-bridge-march.mistake: Hips dropping or tilting as you lift a foot.

steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
wg_frog-pump.back: Do not arch at the top.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Keep one knee bent and lift that foot up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your bottom at the top.
Lower. Switch legs after your set.
wg_donkey-kick.legs: Working knee stays bent at a right angle.
wg_donkey-kick.mistake: Arching your back to lift higher.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Lift one bent knee out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower. Switch legs after your set.
wg_fire-hydrant.back: Back flat; do not lean away.
wg_fire-hydrant.mistake: Shifting your body to lift the knee.

steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee up like a clam opening.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
wg_clamshell.hands: Rest your head on your bottom arm; top hand on your hip.
wg_clamshell.back: Do not roll your hips back.

steps: Stand on one leg and lean forward until your body is level.
Hold a support if needed.
Slowly rotate your hips open, then closed.
Switch legs.
Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Lift your top leg up.
Pause.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
wg_side-lying-hip-abduction.hands: Rest your head on your arm.
wg_side-lying-hip-abduction.legs: Top leg straight, toes facing forward.
wg_side-lying-hip-abduction.back: Hips stacked; do not roll back.
wg_side-lying-hip-abduction.mistake: Rolling back and lifting with the front of your hip.

steps: Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly.
Switch sides after your set.
wg_side-lying-leg-raise.hands: Rest your head on your arm; top hand in front.

steps: Lie on your back and lift your hips into a bridge.
Walk your heels away from you in small steps.
Walk them back in.
Keep your hips up.
Lie on a smooth floor with heels on a towel.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels out straight.
Pull them back in.
wg_towel-hamstring-curl.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a ball.
Lift your hips.
Roll the ball in toward your bottom.
Roll it back out.
wg_stability-ball-hamstring-curl.hands: Arms out to the sides, palms down.
wg_stability-ball-hamstring-curl.breathe: Breathe out as you roll in.

steps: Put a band around your legs just above your knees.
Lie on your back with knees bent.
Push your knees out and lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
wg_banded-glute-bridge.legs: Knees press out against the band.

steps: Sit against a bench with a band above your knees.
Plant your feet.
Push your knees out and lift your hips level.
Lower slowly.
wg_banded-hip-thrust.hands: Hands on the bench or your hips.
wg_banded-hip-thrust.legs: Knees press out against the band.
wg_banded-hip-thrust.back: Upper back on the bench; ribs down.
wg_banded-hip-thrust.mistake: Arching your back at the top.

steps: Lie on your back with a band above your knees.
Put the soles of your feet together.
Lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
Put a band above your knees and lie on your side.
Bend your knees, feet together.
Lift your top knee against the band.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
wg_banded-clamshell.hands: Head on your arm, top hand on your hip.

steps: Put a band around your legs above the knees or at the ankles.
Bend your knees a little.
Step sideways, keeping the band tight.
Walk back the other way.
wg_banded-lateral-walk.legs: Knees push out; feet never touch.

steps: Get on hands and knees with a band around your feet.
Keep your knee bent and push one foot up.
Squeeze your bottom.
Lower. Switch legs after your set.
Get on hands and knees with a band above your knees.
Lift one bent knee out to the side.
Pause.
Lower. Switch legs after your set.
Loop a band around your ankles, holding a wall for balance.
Kick one leg straight back.
Squeeze your bottom.
Return slowly. Switch legs after your set.
Loop a band around your ankles and hold a wall.
Lift one leg out to the side.
Pause.
Return slowly. Switch legs after your set.
Sit on a bench with a band above your knees.
Feet flat, knees together.
Push your knees apart.
Return slowly.
wg_banded-seated-hip-abduction.hands: Hands on the bench beside you.
wg_banded-seated-hip-abduction.back: Sit tall or lean slightly forward.

steps: Fix a band at head height and hold both ends.
Step back, arms straight.
Pull toward your face, elbows high.
Return slowly.
Fix a band at chest height and hold both ends.
Step back until the band is tight.
Pull your hands to your ribs.
Return slowly.
Fix a band high above you.
Kneel or sit and hold the ends, arms up.
Pull your elbows down to your sides.
Return slowly.
wg_banded-lat-pulldown.arms: Pull your elbows down and back.
wg_banded-lat-pulldown.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down.

steps: Fix a band at chest height and stand side-on.
Hold the band at your chest.
Press your arms straight out.
Hold, then return. Switch sides.
Fix a band high and stand side-on.
Hold it with both hands above your shoulder.
Pull down and across your body.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
Lie on your back holding a band fixed behind your head.
Lift your knees over your hips, arms straight up.
Straighten one leg toward the floor.
Bring it back and switch legs.
wg_banded-dead-bug.hands: Hold the band above your chest.
wg_banded-dead-bug.legs: Knees bent at a right angle.
wg_banded-dead-bug.back: Lower back pressed to the floor.

steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor.
Hold still.
wg_hollow-body-hold.arms: Arms by your ears; bring them forward to make it easier.
wg_hollow-body-hold.legs: Legs straight and together; bend knees to make it easier.
wg_hollow-body-hold.back: Lower back stays glued to the floor.
wg_hollow-body-hold.mistake: Letting your lower back lift off the floor.

steps: Get into a hollow body hold.
Rock gently forward and back like a rocking chair.
Keep the same shape the whole time.
Keep rocking for the time set.
wg_hollow-rock.back: Back stays rounded like a banana.
wg_hollow-rock.mistake: Bending at the hips and losing the shape.

steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Lower slowly.
wg_v-up.back: Lower back controlled on the way down.

steps: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Put your hands by your sides or under your bottom.
Lift your legs up until they point at the ceiling.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
wg_lying-leg-raise.hands: Palms down by your sides or under your hips.
wg_lying-leg-raise.legs: Legs straight; bend knees to make it easier.
wg_lying-leg-raise.back: Lower back stays on the floor.
wg_lying-leg-raise.mistake: Letting your back arch as legs lower.

steps: Lie on your back with legs pointing up.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.
wg_toe-touch.legs: Legs straight up, or knees slightly bent.

steps: Start in a high plank on your hands.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Put it down and switch hands.
Keep your hips still.
Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep going.
Get on your hands and knees.
Tuck your toes under.
Lift your knees just off the floor.
Hold still.
Start in a bear plank, knees hovering.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward.
Then the other hand and foot.
Keep crawling forward.
wg_bear-crawl.legs: Knees stay low, just off the floor.

steps: Sit with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Walk using your hands and feet.
Keep your hips up.
Sit between two sturdy supports or on the floor.
Press your hands down to lift your body.
Hold your legs straight out in front.
Hold still.
wg_l-sit-hold.legs: Legs straight; bend knees to make it easier.

steps: Sit and lean back on your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Push your legs back out.
wg_seated-knee-tuck.hands: Hands behind you on the floor.
wg_seated-knee-tuck.back: Lean back with a straight back.
wg_seated-knee-tuck.breathe: Breathe out as you tuck in.

steps: Get into a side plank on your elbow.
Lower your hips toward the floor.
Lift them back up.
Switch sides.
Lie on your side with your top leg on a bench.
Prop up on your elbow.
Lift your hips so your body is straight.
Hold, then switch sides.
wg_copenhagen-plank.legs: Top leg on the bench; bottom leg hangs or lifts.

steps: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your body up onto your upper back.
Lower your straight body slowly.
Stop before you touch the bench.
wg_dragon-flag.hands: Grip the bench firmly behind your head.
wg_dragon-flag.back: Body straight; only your upper back on the bench.
wg_dragon-flag.mistake: Trying this without a strong core base.

steps: Squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in.
Jump up with your arms overhead.
wg_burpee.breathe: Breathe out as you jump up.
wg_burpee.mistake: Letting your hips sag in the plank.

steps: Squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Jump or step them back in.
Stand up.
Squat and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Jump them back to your hands.
Repeat.
wg_squat-thrust.mistake: Hips sagging when you land in the plank.

steps: Stand tall.
Run in place, lifting your knees up high.
Pump your arms.
Keep going for the time set.
wg_high-knees.legs: Knees up to hip height; land on the balls of your feet.
wg_high-knees.back: Stand tall; do not lean back.

steps: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet out and lift your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start.
Keep a steady rhythm.
wg_jumping-jack.arms: Arms swing up overhead and back down.
wg_jumping-jack.legs: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

steps: Stand on one leg.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the back leg behind you.
Hop back the other way.
wg_skater-hop.legs: Land softly with a bent knee.

steps: Stand in a half squat.
Shuffle sideways quickly.
Do not cross your feet.
Shuffle back.
wg_lateral-shuffle.mistake: Standing up tall as you move.

steps: Stand in a half squat.
Tap your feet up and down as fast as you can.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for the time set.
Stand ready, then drop your hands to the floor.
Kick your legs back and let your hips sink.
Jump your feet back in.
Stand up quickly.
Stand with arms straight out in front.
Jump your feet out as you open your arms wide.
Jump back and clap your hands in front.
Keep a steady rhythm.
wg_seal-jack.arms: Arms at shoulder height, open and close.

steps: Stand side-on to a wall and hold it.
Swing your outside leg forward and back.
Start small and let the swings grow.
Switch legs.
wg_leg-swings-stretch.legs: Swinging leg relaxed; standing knee soft.
wg_leg-swings-stretch.mistake: Swinging so hard you lose control.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold your arms loosely at chest height.
Gently turn your upper body to one side.
Turn to the other side. Keep it smooth.
wg_torso-twist-stretch.back: Stand tall; turn from your middle.

steps: Stand in a doorway.
Place your forearms on the door frame at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean gently.
Hold where you feel a stretch in your chest.
wg_doorway-chest-stretch.mistake: Leaning too hard and straining your shoulders.

steps: Stand and put one heel forward, toes up.
Bend your back knee a little.
Lean forward from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold, then switch legs.
wg_hamstring-stretch.hands: Rest your hands on your thighs.
wg_hamstring-stretch.legs: Front leg straight; back knee bent.
wg_hamstring-stretch.back: Back flat; lean from your hips.
wg_hamstring-stretch.mistake: Rounding your back to reach further.

steps: Stand tall and hold a wall if needed.
Bend one knee and hold your foot behind you.
Pull your heel gently toward your bottom.
Hold, then switch legs.
wg_standing-quad-stretch.legs: Knees side by side; standing knee soft.
wg_standing-quad-stretch.back: Stand tall; tuck your bottom under a little.
wg_standing-quad-stretch.mistake: Letting the bent knee drift forward or out.

steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight.
Sit tall.
Lean forward from your hips toward your toes.
Hold where you feel a stretch.
wg_seated-forward-fold-stretch.hands: Rest your hands on your legs or feet.
wg_seated-forward-fold-stretch.legs: Legs straight; bend knees slightly if tight.
wg_seated-forward-fold-stretch.back: Lead with your chest; do not hunch.
wg_seated-forward-fold-stretch.breathe: Breathe out to fold a little deeper.
wg_seated-forward-fold-stretch.mistake: Rounding your back to reach your toes.

steps: Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Hold it with your other arm above the elbow.
Gently pull it closer.
Hold, then switch arms.
wg_cross-body-shoulder-stretch.hands: Other hand holds just above the elbow.
wg_cross-body-shoulder-stretch.back: Stand or sit tall; shoulders down.
wg_cross-body-shoulder-stretch.mistake: Pulling on the elbow joint itself.

steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Hold your feet and sit tall.
Lean forward a little to feel more stretch.
wg_butterfly-stretch.arms: Elbows can rest gently on your thighs.
wg_butterfly-stretch.back: Sit tall; lean from your hips.
wg_butterfly-stretch.breathe: Breathe slowly and relax your hips.

steps: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel.
Roll the wheel forward slowly.
Go only as far as you can control.
Pull back to the start using your belly.
Ab_Roller.back: Keep your back flat; do not let it sag.
Ab_Roller.breathe: Breathe in as you roll out, out as you return.
Ab_Roller.mistake: Rolling too far and letting your back arch.

steps: Lie on your back with a padded bar over your hips.
Bend your knees and put your feet flat.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
Barbell_Glute_Bridge.hands: Hold the bar steady on your hips.
Barbell_Glute_Bridge.legs: Feet hip-width apart, close to your bottom.
Barbell_Glute_Bridge.back: Do not arch at the top.

steps: Hold the dip bars and lift yourself up.
Lean your body forward a little.
Bend your elbows to lower down.
Push back up.
Dips_-_Chest_Version.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Dips_-_Chest_Version.mistake: Going too deep for your shoulders.

steps: Lean forward with your hips under the pad or a partner.
Put the balls of your feet on a step.
Rise up onto your toes.
Lower slowly.
Donkey_Calf_Raises.hands: Hold the handles or a support.

steps: Stand holding a barbell, palms up.
Curl the bar up while dragging it along your body.
Let your elbows move back.
Lower slowly the same way.
Drag_Curl.arms: Elbows go back as the bar rises.
Drag_Curl.mistake: Letting the bar move away from your body.

steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to step back. Switch legs.
Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.hands: Dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Step on and hold the handles.
Start moving your legs in smooth loops.
Push and pull with your arms too.
Keep a steady pace.
Elliptical_Trainer.legs: Keep your feet flat on the pedals.

steps: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand.
Stand tall.
Walk forward with short, quick steps.
Set the weights down carefully.
Farmers_Walk.mistake: Rounding your back when picking up the weights.

steps: Kneel with your ankles held down by a partner or pad.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower yourself forward slowly.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up.
Floor_Glute-Ham_Raise.back: Body straight; hips do not bend.

steps: Stand holding a weight plate at your thighs.
Lift it straight in front to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Front_Plate_Raise.hands: Hold the plate at the sides, like a steering wheel.

steps: Rest a light bar across your upper back.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lean forward.
Stand back up.
Good_Morning.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Good_Morning.breathe: Breathe in as you lean, out as you rise.

steps: Set an incline bench between two low cables.
Lie back with a handle in each hand.
Bring your hands together over your upper chest.
Open your arms slowly.
Incline_Cable_Flye.arms: Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Incline_Cable_Flye.breathe: Breathe out as you bring hands together.
Incline_Cable_Flye.mistake: Bending your elbows like a press.

steps: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell.
Lean forward as your other leg goes back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor.
Stand back up. Switch legs.
Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift.legs: Standing knee soft; back leg straight.
Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms to lift them back.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lying_Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you lift.

steps: Kneel with your feet held down.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower yourself forward slowly.
Pull back up with your hamstrings, using your hands if needed.
Start in a push-up with your hands close together under your chest.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Push back up.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Push-Ups_-_Close_Triceps_Position.hands: Hands close together under your chest.
Push-Ups_-_Close_Triceps_Position.arms: Elbows stay close to your sides.
Push-Ups_-_Close_Triceps_Position.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Set a barbell on rack pins at knee height.
Grip the bar with your back flat.
Stand up tall with the bar.
Lower it back to the pins.
Rack_Pulls.legs: Knees slightly bent at the start.

steps: Lie face down on the machine, hips at the edge.
Hold the handles.
Lift your legs up behind you until level.
Lower slowly.
Reverse_Hyperextension.back: Lift only until legs are level.

steps: Hold one rope handle in each hand.
Swing the rope over your head.
Hop lightly as it passes your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Rope_Jumping.arms: Elbows close to your sides; turn with your wrists.
Rope_Jumping.legs: Small hops on the balls of your feet.

steps: Strap your feet in and hold the handle.
Push with your legs first.
Then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your ribs.
Reverse: arms, body, then legs.
Rowing_Stationary.arms: Arms straight until your legs have pushed.

steps: Sit at a low cable with one handle.
Hold it with one arm straight.
Pull the handle to your side.
Return slowly. Switch arms after your set.
Seated_One-arm_Cable_Pulley_Rows.back: Sit tall; do not twist much.

steps: Step on and start slowly.
Climb at a steady pace.
Use the rails only for balance.
Slow down for the last few minutes.
Stairmaster.hands: Rest your hands lightly on the rails.
Stairmaster.legs: Use your whole foot on each step.

steps: Step on and start slowly.
Climb at a steady pace.
Hold the rails lightly.
Slow down at the end.
Stand with feet wide, toes out, bar close to your shins.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
Push the floor away and stand up tall.
Lower the bar the same way.
Sumo_Deadlift.legs: Knees push out over your toes.

steps: Wear a dip belt with a weight.
Hang from the bar.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly.
Weighted_Pull_Ups.mistake: Adding weight before bodyweight pull-ups feel easy.

steps: Step into a long lunge.
Put the hand on the same side as your front foot inside it.
Turn and reach the other arm up to the ceiling.
Return and switch sides.
Worlds_Greatest_Stretch.hands: One hand on the floor; the other reaches up.
Worlds_Greatest_Stretch.legs: Front knee over your ankle; back leg long.
Worlds_Greatest_Stretch.breathe: Breathe out as you reach up.

steps: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat, chest up.
Push up through your feet.
Front_Barbell_Squat.hands: Fingertips under the bar, elbows high.
Front_Barbell_Squat.mistake: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.

steps: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head slowly toward the floor.
Push back up.
Come down carefully.
Handstand_Push-Ups.mistake: Trying it before mastering wall handstands.

steps: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Lift your straight legs up in front of you.
Lower them slowly.
Keep your body from swinging.
Hanging_Leg_Raise.back: Curl your hips at the top.

steps: Hold a barbell at your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders.
Push_Press.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders.
Push_Press.arms: Arms straight overhead at the top.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet held down.
Put your hands lightly beside your head.
Sit up about three quarters of the way.
Lower back down slowly.
3_4_Sit-Up.hands: Fingertips lightly beside your head. Do not pull.
3_4_Sit-Up.back: Curl up smoothly; lower with control.
3_4_Sit-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you sit up.

steps: Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor.
Bend the other hip and knee to right angles.
Hold behind that thigh with your hands.
Slowly straighten that knee until you feel a stretch. Switch legs.
90_90_Hamstring.legs: Thigh stays pointing up as the knee straightens.

steps: Stand with one foot slightly in front.
Push off and leap diagonally to the side.
Drive the other knee up as you go.
Land softly and leap back the other way.
Alternate_Leg_Diagonal_Bound.arms: Swing your arms to help you leap.
Alternate_Leg_Diagonal_Bound.legs: Land on a soft, bent knee.
Alternate_Leg_Diagonal_Bound.breathe: Breathe out as you push off.

steps: Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Switch direction, then switch feet.
Ankle_Circles.legs: Only the ankle moves; the leg stays still.
Ankle_Circles.mistake: Moving the whole leg instead of the ankle.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the other knee.
Hold the bottom thigh and pull both legs toward you.
Hold, then switch sides.
Ankle_On_The_Knee.legs: Top ankle rests on the other knee.
Ankle_On_The_Knee.back: Head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Ankle_On_The_Knee.mistake: Lifting your head and tensing your neck.

steps: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet a little.
Pull your knees in and lift your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Bent-Knee_Hip_Raise.legs: Keep the same bend in your knees.
Bent-Knee_Hip_Raise.back: Upper back stays on the floor.
Bent-Knee_Hip_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you lift your hips.

steps: Hold a bar set at chest height, hands shoulder-width.
Step back and lean on it with straight arms.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the bar.
Straighten your arms to push back.
Body_Tricep_Press.back: Body straight from head to heels.
Body_Tricep_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Tuck your knees to your chest.
Push your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Lift your hips a little, then lower slowly.
Bottoms_Up.legs: Legs straight up at the top.

steps: Start in a plank on your forearms.
Lift your bottom up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your belly.
Lower back to the plank.
Butt-Ups.hands: Hands flat or in loose fists.
Butt-Ups.back: Back flat when you return to the plank.
Butt-Ups.mistake: Letting your hips sag on the way down.

steps: Stand facing a wall a little away.
Lean in and rest your forearms on the wall.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Hold where you feel a stretch.
Stand with feet a little apart.
Step one foot quickly behind the other and lift the knee.
Keep moving sideways in a quick rhythm.
Switch direction.
Sit tall on a chair.
Raise one arm over your head.
Lean gently to the other side.
Hold, then switch sides.
Chair_Lower_Back_Stretch.hands: Free hand holds the chair seat.
Chair_Lower_Back_Stretch.arms: Raised arm reaches up and over.
Chair_Lower_Back_Stretch.back: Lean straight to the side, not forward.

steps: Sit tall.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lower your chin toward your chest.
Hold, then lift your head slowly.
Chin_To_Chest_Stretch.hands: Fingers laced behind your head; use their weight only.
Chin_To_Chest_Stretch.back: Sit tall; let only your neck bend.

steps: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms overhead.
Tuck your knees to your chest.
At the same time, bring your arms over and lift your shoulders.
Return to lying long.
Cocoons.arms: Arms swing from overhead to around your knees.
Cocoons.legs: Knees pull in toward your chest.
Cocoons.back: Curl into a ball, then lengthen out.
Cocoons.breathe: Breathe out as you curl in.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Put your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower and switch sides.
Cross-Body_Crunch.legs: Feet flat; lift the knee to meet the elbow.
Cross-Body_Crunch.breathe: Breathe out as you twist up.
Cross-Body_Crunch.mistake: Pulling your head with your hands.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Stretch your arms straight overhead.
Curl your shoulders up, keeping arms by your ears.
Lower slowly.
Lie on your back with your calves on an exercise ball.
Put your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up.
Lower slowly.
Crunch_-_Legs_On_Exercise_Ball.legs: Knees bent at about a right angle on the ball.

steps: Sit on the floor with your left leg straight.
Cross your right foot over, knee bent.
Place your left arm on your right knee.
Turn your body to the right and hold. Switch sides.
Dancers_Stretch.hands: Back hand on the floor behind you.
Dancers_Stretch.arms: Front arm gently presses the knee.
Dancers_Stretch.legs: Bottom leg straight; top knee bent.

steps: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back.
Raise your body partway up.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower and switch sides.
Lie on a decline bench, holding the top.
Lift your legs.
Curl your hips up toward your chest.
Lower slowly.
Decline_Reverse_Crunch.hands: Hold the bench above your head.

steps: Stand with knees slightly bent.
Dip down and jump straight up.
Kick both heels up toward your bottom.
Land softly and repeat.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your straight arms up overhead several times.
Then swing them out to the sides several times.
Keep the moves smooth.
Stand with arms straight out in front, hands together.
Swing your arms back and open as far as is comfy.
Bring them back together.
Repeat.
Dynamic_Chest_Stretch.mistake: Arching your back as you open.

steps: Sit or stand tall.
Put your fingertips on your shoulders.
Draw big circles with your elbows.
Switch direction.
Lie on your back and cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Put your hands behind your head.
Curl up and bring your left elbow toward your right knee.
Lower. Switch sides after your set.
Elbow_to_Knee.legs: Bottom foot flat; top ankle on the knee.

steps: Stand tall.
Put your hands on your lower back, fingers down.
Gently pull your elbows back toward each other.
Hold, then relax.
Elbows_Back.hands: Palms on your lower back, fingers point down.
Elbows_Back.back: Stand tall; do not lean back.

steps: Stand relaxed with one leg slightly forward.
Skip: step, hop, then switch legs.
Stay low and quick to the ground.
Keep going for the time set.
Fast_Skipping.arms: Swing your arms with each skip.
Fast_Skipping.legs: Quick, small skips on the balls of your feet.

steps: Lie on a bench with your legs off the end.
Hold the bench or put your hands under your bottom.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Push your legs back out.
Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.legs: Legs straighten without touching the floor.
Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.back: Lower back stays on the bench.
Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Lie on a bench with your legs off the end.
Hold the bench.
Lift your straight legs up.
Lower slowly.
Flat_Bench_Lying_Leg_Raise.legs: Legs straight; slight knee bend is fine.

steps: Stand side-on to a chair and hold it.
Swing your outside leg forward.
Let it swing back.
Repeat, then switch legs.
Kneel on all fours.
Lift one leg back and up, knee bent.
Squeeze your bottom at the top.
Lower. Switch legs after your set.
Lie on your back and loop a band or belt around one foot.
Lift that leg up toward the ceiling.
Gently pull with the band.
Hold, then switch legs.
Hamstring_Stretch.legs: Raised leg straight; other leg flat.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Lift one bent knee off the floor.
Draw big slow circles with that knee.
Switch sides.
Place your hands close together on a raised bar or edge.
Walk your feet back so your body is straight.
Lower your chest to your hands.
Push back up.
Incline_Push-Up_Close-Grip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Place your hands shoulder-width on a raised bar or edge.
Walk your feet back so your body is straight.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up.
Incline_Push-Up_Medium.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
Incline_Push-Up_Medium.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Hold a raised bar with palms facing up.
Walk your feet back so your body is straight.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up.
Incline_Push-Up_Reverse_Grip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Place your hands wide on a raised bar or edge.
Walk your feet back so your body is straight.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up.
Incline_Push-Up_Wide.arms: Elbows bend out at an angle.
Incline_Push-Up_Wide.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Sit or stand tall.
Press your palms together in front of your chest.
Push your hands together and hold.
Relax slowly.
Isometric_Chest_Squeezes.arms: Elbows bent at about a right angle.

steps: Sit tall with your head level.
Put both hands on your forehead.
Gently push your head into your hands without moving. Hold.
Then put your hands behind your head and push back. Hold.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Front_And_Back.hands: Palms on your forehead, then behind your head.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Front_And_Back.back: Sit tall; your head does not move.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Front_And_Back.mistake: Pushing too hard too fast. Start gently.

steps: Sit tall with your head level.
Put your left hand on the left side of your head.
Gently push your head into your hand without moving. Hold.
Relax slowly, then do the right side.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Sides.hands: Palm flat on the side of your head.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Sides.back: Sit tall; your head stays still.
Isometric_Neck_Exercise_-_Sides.mistake: Pushing hard straight away instead of building up.

steps: Start in a push-up position, hands a bit wide.
Shift your body to one side, bending that elbow.
Shift back to the middle.
Then shift to the other side.
Isometric_Wipers.hands: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Isometric_Wipers.arms: One arm bends as you shift toward it.

steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs to meet over your hips.
Reach for your toes.
Lower slowly.
Lie with knees bent and feet flat.
Squeeze your bottom and the back of your legs.
Sit up very slowly.
Lower slowly.
Janda_Sit-Up.legs: Feet flat; press your heels into the floor.
Janda_Sit-Up.back: Curl up one bit at a time.
Janda_Sit-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you sit up.

steps: Stand with your feet together.
Bend your knees a little and rest your hands on them.
Circle your knees slowly.
Switch direction.
Knee_Circles.hands: Hands rest lightly on your knees.
Knee_Circles.back: Lean forward a little with a flat back.
Knee_Circles.mistake: Pressing down hard on your knees.

steps: Stand with knees slightly bent.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly.
Jump again.
Knee_Tuck_Jump.hands: Hands out at chest height as a target.

steps: Kneel with one foot forward.
Swing your arms like you are running.
Start slow, then speed up.
Keep your body still.
Kneeling_Arm_Drill.arms: Elbows bent; swing from the shoulders.
Kneeling_Arm_Drill.legs: One knee down, one foot forward.

steps: Kneel and put your palms flat, fingers pointing back at your knees.
Slowly lean back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your forearms.
Hold.
Kneeling_Forearm_Stretch.hands: Palms flat, fingers point toward your knees.

steps: Stand in a half squat.
Push off one leg and leap sideways.
Land on the other leg softly.
Leap back.
Lateral_Bound.legs: Land on a soft, bent knee.
Lateral_Bound.breathe: Breathe out as you push off.

steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat.
Lift the other leg up.
Hold the back of the raised leg.
Gently draw it toward you. Hold, then switch.
Leg-Up_Hamstring_Stretch.hands: Hold behind your thigh or calf.
Leg-Up_Hamstring_Stretch.legs: Raised leg as straight as is comfy.

steps: Stand tall holding a chair.
Bend one knee and lift that heel toward your bottom.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs after your set.
Stand at a line with one foot a little ahead.
Crouch and put one hand on the line.
Push off hard and sprint a few steps.
Walk back and repeat.
Linear_3-Part_Start_Technique.arms: Drive your arms hard as you start.
Linear_3-Part_Start_Technique.breathe: Breathe out as you push off.

steps: Lean into a wall with your body straight.
Lift one knee quickly.
Drive that foot down into the floor.
Switch legs.
Linear_Acceleration_Wall_Drill.legs: Quick knee lift, strong push down.

steps: Kneel and hold your heels.
Push your hips forward.
Look up at the ceiling.
Hold gently, then come back up.
Looking_At_Ceiling.back: Gentle arch; do not force it.

steps: Lie face down with arms out to the sides.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Do not push with your arms.
Lower slowly.
Lower_Back_Curl.back: Lift gently with your back muscles.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips.
Gently twist at your waist to one side.
Hold where you feel a stretch.
Twist to the other side.
Jog forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your bottom as the leg goes back.
Pull the foot through and step down under you.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Moving_Claw_Series.arms: Elbows bent; punch your arms forward and back.
Moving_Claw_Series.legs: Heel kicks up, then the foot claws the ground.
Moving_Claw_Series.mistake: Reaching the foot far in front of your body.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Put one hand behind your head.
Curl up and twist that elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower. Switch sides after your set.
Oblique_Crunches.hands: One hand lightly behind your head.

steps: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent.
Put your top hand behind your head.
Lift your shoulder up toward your hip.
Lower. Switch sides after your set.
Oblique_Crunches_-_On_The_Floor.hands: Top hand lightly behind your head.
Oblique_Crunches_-_On_The_Floor.back: Crunch straight up to the side.

steps: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent in front.
Bend your top knee and hold that foot.
Gently pull your heel toward your bottom.
Hold, then switch sides.
On_Your_Side_Quad_Stretch.legs: Top knee points down, in line with your hip.

steps: Stand next to a wall or doorway.
Place your bent arm on the wall above your head.
Lean gently into the wall.
Hold, then switch arms.
One_Arm_Against_Wall.arms: Forearm on the wall, elbow up.

steps: Lie face down.
Bend one knee and hold that foot with the same hand.
Lift your foot and shoulders a little.
Hold, then switch sides.
One_Half_Locust.hands: Other hand under your hip for padding.
One_Half_Locust.back: Lift gently; do not force it.

steps: Lie on your back.
Keep one leg straight on the floor.
Pull the other knee toward your chest.
Hold, then switch legs.
One_Knee_To_Chest.hands: Hold just under your knee, not on top.
One_Knee_To_Chest.legs: Straight leg stays long on the floor.
One_Knee_To_Chest.back: Lower back relaxes into the floor.
One_Knee_To_Chest.mistake: Holding on top of the kneecap.

steps: Stand tall and lace your fingers together.
Turn your palms up and push your arms overhead.
Keep your shoulders down.
Hold and reach tall.
Overhead_Stretch.hands: Fingers laced, palms to the ceiling.

steps: Put your feet on a bench or step.
Place your hands on the floor, a bit wider than shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.hands: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.legs: Legs straight, toes on the bench.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Do one push-up.
At the top, turn onto one hand and reach the other arm up.
Turn back to the push-up position.
Do another push-up, then turn the other way.
Push_Up_to_Side_Plank.arms: Top arm reaches to the ceiling.
Push_Up_to_Side_Plank.legs: Feet stack or stagger in the side plank.
Push_Up_to_Side_Plank.mistake: Hips dropping in the side plank.

steps: Start in a push-up with hands wide.
Do a push-up.
Move your hands close together.
Do a push-up. Keep switching.
Pushups_Close_and_Wide_Hand_Positions.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
Pushups_Close_and_Wide_Hand_Positions.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Lift one leg straight back.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat halfway down.
Jump up high, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Put your hands on the floor beside your front foot.
Lower your back knee if you like.
Hold, then switch sides.
Runners_Stretch.hands: Hands on the floor by your front foot.
Runners_Stretch.legs: Front heel down; back leg long.
Runners_Stretch.mistake: Front knee going past your toes.

steps: Lie on your back, arms out to the sides.
Lift your heels a little off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other, then switch.
Keep crossing.
Scissor_Kick.legs: Legs almost straight, heels just off the floor.

steps: Sit tall with one leg straight.
Bend the other knee, foot flat.
Loop a towel around the straight foot.
Gently pull your toes toward you. Hold, then switch.
Seated_Calf_Stretch.legs: Straight leg flat on the floor.

steps: Sit on a bench, hold the sides, and lean back.
Stretch your legs out in front.
Pull your knees in as your chest comes forward.
Push back out.
Seated_Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.legs: Legs straighten without touching the floor.
Seated_Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.back: Lean back with a straight back.
Seated_Flat_Bench_Leg_Pull-In.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Sit with your right leg straight.
Bend your left knee, foot against your inner thigh.
Lean forward from your hips over the straight leg.
Hold, then switch.
Seated_Floor_Hamstring_Stretch.hands: Rest on your leg or foot.
Seated_Floor_Hamstring_Stretch.breathe: Breathe out to lean a little deeper.

steps: Sit on a bench, hold the sides, lean back.
Stretch your legs out.
Tuck your knees in.
Push back out.
Seated_Leg_Tucks.back: Lean back with a straight back.

steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Put one hand on the floor beside you.
Put the other hand behind your head.
Lean to the side, elbow up. Hold, then switch.
Seated_Overhead_Stretch.hands: One hand on the floor, one behind your head.
Seated_Overhead_Stretch.arms: Top elbow points to the ceiling.
Seated_Overhead_Stretch.back: Lean to the side, not forward.

steps: Stand or sit with arms relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Let them drop down.
Shoulder_Raise.breathe: Breathe in as you lift, out as you drop.

steps: Reach one arm across your body.
Hold it with your other hand.
Gently pull closer.
Hold, then switch arms.
Lie on your left side, left knee bent in front.
Put your right foot behind you on the floor.
Reach your right arm overhead.
Hold, then switch sides.
Side-Lying_Floor_Stretch.back: Feel the stretch along your side.

steps: Lie on your side, legs straight.
Put your top hand behind your head.
Lift your legs and upper body toward each other.
Lower. Switch sides after your set.
Side_Jackknife.hands: Top hand lightly behind your head.
Side_Jackknife.legs: Legs together, lifting from the hip.

steps: Stand next to a chair and hold it.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.
Lie on your side, bottom knee bent.
Rest your head on your hand.
Lift your top leg and hold it with your top hand.
Hold the stretch, then switch.
Side_Lying_Groin_Stretch.hands: Hold your top ankle or knee.
Side_Lying_Groin_Stretch.legs: Top leg lifts as high as comfy.

steps: Stand side-on in a half squat.
Swing your arms and jump sideways as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet.
Reset and repeat.
Stand tall.
Cross one arm in front and hold that wrist with the other hand.
Gently pull it across and up to shoulder height.
Hold, then switch sides.
Side_Wrist_Pull.back: Feel the stretch in your upper back.
Side_Wrist_Pull.mistake: Pulling too hard on the shoulder.

steps: Stand on one leg with the other knee up.
Jump up off the standing leg.
Kick that heel toward your bottom.
Land softly. Switch legs after your set.
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet held.
Put your hands lightly beside your head.
Sit all the way up.
Lower slowly.
Sit-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you sit up.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down.
Go as low as is comfy.
Stand back up.
Sit_Squats.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Start in a low push-up position.
Bring one knee up toward the same elbow.
Move your hands and feet forward as you go.
Switch sides and keep crawling.
Spider_Crawl.legs: Knee comes out to the side toward the elbow.

steps: Sit tall in a chair, feet flat.
Lace your fingers behind your head, elbows out.
Gently twist your upper body to one side.
Come back and twist to the other side.
Start in a lunge.
Jump up and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching.
Put one heel on a step, knee straight.
Lean forward and reach for your toes.
Keep the other knee slightly bent.
Hold, then switch.
Standing_Gastrocnemius_Calf_Stretch.legs: Front leg straight; heel on the step.

steps: Stand on one leg holding a support.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Draw big slow circles with that knee.
Switch sides.
Stand with one foot a little in front.
Bend both knees and lift the back heel.
Tuck your bottom under.
Hold, then switch.
Stand with feet a little wider than hips.
Put one hand on your hip.
Raise the other arm and lean to the side.
Hold, then switch.
Standing_Lateral_Stretch.arms: Top arm reaches up and over.

steps: Stand in a half squat with feet shoulder-width.
Swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet.
Reset and repeat.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Soften your knees.
Rock your hips forward and back a few times.
Hold with your tailbone tucked under.
Stand with one foot a little in front.
Bend both knees.
Keep your back heel on the floor.
Hold, then switch.
Standing_Soleus_And_Achilles_Stretch.legs: Both knees bent; back heel down.

steps: Stand with feet together.
Bend forward and let your upper body hang.
Reach toward your toes.
Roll up slowly.
Standing_Toe_Touches.back: Let it hang; roll up slowly.

steps: Hold a towel overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your hands behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat halfway.
Jump up and spread your arms and legs like a star.
Land softly.
Star_Jump.arms: Arms spread wide in the air.

steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Breathe out fully.
Pull your belly button in toward your spine.
Hold, breathing lightly, then release.
Stomach_Vacuum.breathe: Take small, light breaths during the hold.

steps: Sit with your legs out wide in a V.
Sit tall.
Lean forward with your hands on the floor.
Hold where you feel a stretch.
The_Straddle.hands: Hands on the floor in front.

steps: Lie on your back with legs up toward the ceiling.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Wear shoes with good grip.
Start at an easy pace.
Take short steps going up and down hills.
Slow down on rough or steep ground.
Trail_Running_Walking.back: Stay tall; look a few steps ahead.

steps: Bring one arm across your body and over the other shoulder.
Hold that elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull.
Hold, then switch.
Tricep_Side_Stretch.arms: Stretching arm bent over your shoulder.

steps: Reach one hand down behind your head.
Hold that elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull.
Hold, then switch.
Lie on your back with knees up over your hips.
Cross your ankles.
Curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
Tuck_Crunch.hands: Palms down by your sides or reaching forward.

steps: Sit with your legs out in front, knees together.
Bend forward and hug your thighs from underneath.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold.
Clasp your hands, thumbs down.
Reach your hands forward.
Round your shoulders and upper back.
Hold.
Reach both arms straight above your head.
Press your palms together.
Gently push your hands up and back.
Hold.
Hang a V-bar over a pull-up bar.
Hold the handles, palms facing each other.
Pull up until your chest nears the handles.
Lower slowly.
V-Bar_Pullup.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.

steps: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Lift one knee up high.
Lower it as the other knee comes up.
Keep switching without swinging.
Wind_Sprints.legs: Knees drive up one at a time.

steps: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make circles with your hands.
Keep everything else still.
Switch direction.
Lie face down with your legs straight.
Have a partner rest a hand on your heel.
Curl your heel up toward your bottom as they gently resist.
Lower slowly while they keep light pressure.
Prone_Manual_Hamstring.legs: Only the knee bends; hips stay down.
Prone_Manual_Hamstring.back: Hips stay flat on the floor.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other one.
Alternate_Hammer_Curl.hands: Palms face your body the whole time.

steps: Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging.
Curl one dumbbell up, palm up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other one.
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the weights in front to shoulder height.
Lower, then raise them out to the sides.
Keep switching.
Alternating_Deltoid_Raise.hands: Palms face down at the top.

steps: Lean forward and rest your forehead on an incline bench.
Let the dumbbells hang below you.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.
Bent_Over_Dumbbell_Rear_Delt_Raise_With_.back: Back flat; head rests on the bench.

steps: Hold dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Bend knees slightly and lean forward with a flat back.
Pull the dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a bench holding dumbbells together over your chest.
Press the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them to your chest.
Push back up.
Close-Grip_Dumbbell_Press.hands: Palms face each other; dumbbells touching.
Close-Grip_Dumbbell_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.
Lie on a decline bench with legs hooked in.
Hold dumbbells above your chest.
Open your arms out wide.
Bring them back together.
Decline_Dumbbell_Flyes.breathe: Breathe out as you bring them together.

steps: Lie on a decline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep upper arms still.
Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Curl one up, turning your palm up.
Lower slowly.
Curl the other.
Dumbbell_Alternate_Bicep_Curl.hands: Palm turns up as you curl.

steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Turn your palms to face each other.
Lower to the sides of your chest.
Push back up.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press_with_Neutral_Grip.back: Shoulder blades pinched; back on the bench.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press_with_Neutral_Grip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with arms hanging straight.
Pull them up to your ribs.
Lower slowly.
Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells straight up.
Keep your arms straight.
Push the weights up by lifting your shoulder blades.
Lower your shoulders back.
Dumbbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.

steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Lift the dumbbells up and slightly out.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Dumbbell_Raise.hands: Palms face down at the top.

steps: Hold light dumbbells at your sides, thumbs up.
Raise your arms forward and out at an angle, like a V.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Dumbbell_Scaption.arms: Arms straight, in a V shape.

steps: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a block.
Rest a dumbbell on that thigh near the knee.
Push up onto your toes.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise.hands: Hold the dumbbell on your thigh.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise.legs: Knee bent at about a right angle.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.

steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back.
Push up through your feet.
Dumbbell_Squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells straight up.
Turn your palms to face your feet.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your head.
Straighten your arms.
Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Bend that elbow and rest it on your side.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
External_Rotation.arms: Elbow stays tucked at your side.

steps: Sit back on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells off-center, more weight on the thumb side.
Curl them up.
Lower slowly.
Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Raise your straight arms up in front.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Hold them at your chest, palms facing each other.
Press up.
Lower slowly.
Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells at your chest.
Turn your palms to face each other.
Press the dumbbells up.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a low incline bench with dumbbells up.
Bend your elbows slightly.
Open your arms out wide.
Bring them back together.
Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes.arms: Keep the same soft elbow bend.

steps: Lie on a low incline bench with dumbbells up.
Open your arms out wide.
As you bring them back, turn your pinkies in toward each other.
Lower and repeat.
Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes_-_With_A_Twist.hands: Palms turn in as you finish.

steps: Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging.
