Hold dumbbells, palms facing in.
Curl them up.
Lower slowly.
Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging.
Turn your palms to face out.
Curl the dumbbells up and out.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells hanging down at your sides.
Turn your palms up.
Curl the dumbbells up.
Lower slowly.
Lying_Supine_Dumbbell_Curl.arms: Upper arms hang down and stay still.

steps: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell above your chest.
Open that arm out to the side.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch arms after your set.
One-Arm_Flat_Bench_Dumbbell_Flye.breathe: Breathe out as you bring it up.

steps: Lie sideways on an incline bench with a dumbbell.
Lift your top arm out and up.
Stop just above shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Switch sides after your set.
Hold a dumbbell and hold a support with your other hand.
Lean away a little.
Lift the dumbbell out to the side.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
One-Arm_Side_Laterals.hands: Palm faces down at the top.

steps: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell at your chest.
Press it straight up.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your set.
One_Arm_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.back: Keep your body square on the bench.

steps: Rest your upper arm on a preacher or incline bench pad.
Hold a dumbbell, palm up.
Lower it until your arm is nearly straight.
Curl it back up. Switch arms.
One_Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl.arms: Upper arm stays on the pad.
One_Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl.mistake: Dropping the weight at the bottom.

steps: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell straight up.
Turn your palm toward your feet.
Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell across your chest.
Straighten. Switch arms.
Lie on a bench with one dumbbell straight up.
Turn your palm toward your face.
Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Straighten. Switch arms.
Kneel and rest your forearms on a bench.
Hold dumbbells, palms down, wrists over the edge.
Lift the backs of your hands up.
Lower slowly.
Kneel and rest your forearms on a bench.
Hold dumbbells, palms up, wrists over the edge.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.
Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides quickly, just above shoulder height.
Lower right away.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm.
Power_Partials.hands: Palms face in at the start.

steps: Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench pad.
Hold dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Lower until your arms are nearly straight.
Curl back up.
Preacher_Hammer_Dumbbell_Curl.arms: Upper arms stay on the pad.

steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells hanging down, palms in.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.
Sit at the end of a bench and lean forward.
Hold a dumbbell with your upper arm by your side.
Straighten your arm back.
Bend slowly. Switch arms.
Sit on a bench with dumbbells at your sides.
Curl them up, turning palms up.
Lower slowly.
Keep elbows by your sides.
Seated_Dumbbell_Curl.hands: Palms turn up as you curl.

steps: Sit on a bench with dumbbells at your sides.
Curl them up and out, palms up.
Lower slowly.
Keep elbows close.
Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Hold dumbbells with wrists past your knees.
Lift the backs of your hands up.
Lower slowly.
Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Hold dumbbells with wrists past your knees.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.
Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up.
Let the dumbbell roll down to your fingers.
Curl your wrist up.
Lower slowly. Switch hands.
Sit at the end of a bench with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Seated_Side_Lateral_Raise.hands: Palms face down at the top.

steps: Sit on a bench with back support.
Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms.
Seated_Triceps_Press.hands: Cup the top of the dumbbell.
Seated_Triceps_Press.arms: Elbows point up, close to your head.

steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them in front to shoulder height.
Move them out to the sides at the same height.
Lower, and reverse next rep.
Stand wide holding one dumbbell by the end with both hands.
Raise it in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Single_Dumbbell_Raise.hands: Both hands hold the dumbbell end.

steps: Stand wide with a dumbbell in each hand.
Swing both dumbbells to one side of your hips.
Turn and swing them across to the other side.
Keep going side to side.
Spell_Caster.breathe: Breathe out as you swing across.

steps: Stand with dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press one up overhead.
Lower it, then press the other.
Keep switching.
Standing_Alternating_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbows start bent below your hands.

steps: Lean forward with a flat back, dumbbell in one hand.
Bring your upper arm up beside your body.
Straighten your arm back.
Bend slowly. Switch arms.
Lean forward with a flat back, dumbbells in hand.
Bring your upper arms up beside your body.
Straighten both arms back.
Bend slowly.
Lean forward and let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell toward your chest.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.
Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Pull them straight up close to your body.
Stop around chest height.
Lower slowly.
Standing_Dumbbell_Upright_Row.arms: Elbows lead and stay above hands.
Standing_Dumbbell_Upright_Row.mistake: Pulling too high if it pinches.

steps: Stand behind an incline bench.
Rest your upper arm on the top pad.
Curl the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly. Switch arms.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Curl_Over_Incl.arms: Upper arm stays on the pad.

steps: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder, palm facing in.
Hold a support with your other hand.
Press the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly. Switch arms.
Standing_Palm-In_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbow in front of your body.

steps: Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench pad.
Hold dumbbells, palms up.
Lower until arms are nearly straight.
Curl back up.
Two-Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl.arms: Upper arms stay on the pad.

steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Hinge at your hips and swing it back.
Snap your hips forward to swing it up overhead.
Let it swing back down.
Vertical_Swing.breathe: Breathe out as it swings up.
Vertical_Swing.mistake: Lifting with your arms instead of your hips.

steps: Lie on the floor with a kettlebell in each hand at your chest.
Press both up until your arms are straight.
Lower one, press it back up, then the other.
Keep switching.
Alternating_Floor_Press.arms: Upper arms touch the floor at the bottom.

steps: Fix a band to a post and hold the handles.
Step back until the band is tight, arms straight in front.
Pull your arms out to the sides.
Return slowly.
Back_Flyes_-_With_Bands.hands: Palms face each other or down.
Back_Flyes_-_With_Bands.back: Stand tall; squeeze your shoulder blades.

steps: Stand holding a medicine ball, back to your partner or open space.
Squat down with the ball between your legs.
Explode up and throw the ball back over your head.
Reset and repeat.
Backward_Medicine_Ball_Throw.arms: Arms swing straight up and back.

steps: Lie on your back with your heels on an exercise ball.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Roll the ball toward you by bending your knees.
Roll it back out.
Ball_Leg_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you roll in.

steps: Stand on a band and loop the other end behind your neck.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lean forward.
Stand back up.
Band_Good_Morning.hands: Hold the band at your shoulders.

steps: Loop a band around a low post and around the back of your neck.
Face away and step forward.
Hinge forward at your hips.
Stand up tall against the band.
Band_Good_Morning_Pull_Through.hands: Hold the band at your shoulders.

steps: Fix a band low and loop it around your inside ankle.
Stand side-on and hold something for balance.
Pull that leg across in front of your other leg.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Band_Hip_Adductions.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Fix a band low behind your head and lie on a bench.
Hold the band with elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms up.
Bend slowly back.
Band_Skull_Crusher.arms: Upper arms point up and stay still.

steps: Fix a band under the bench and lie down.
Hold the handles at your chest.
Press your arms straight up.
Lower slowly.
Stand on a band and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Rise up onto your toes.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Calf_Raises_-_With_Bands.hands: Hold the handles at your shoulders.

steps: Stand facing a wall or partner with a medicine ball.
Bring the ball behind your head.
Throw it forward hard.
Catch it and repeat.
Catch_and_Overhead_Throw.arms: Arms reach back, then throw forward.
Catch_and_Overhead_Throw.back: Do not arch too far back.

steps: Crouch with one hand down and a medicine ball in front.
Step forward and pull the ball to your chest.
Push the ball forward hard.
Reset and repeat.
Chest_Push_from_3_point_stance.hands: Both hands on the ball at your chest.

steps: Kneel facing a wall or partner holding a medicine ball.
Push your hips forward and throw the ball from your chest.
Catch yourself with your hands.
Push back up and repeat.
Chest_Push_multiple_response.hands: Ball held tight to your chest.
Chest_Push_multiple_response.back: Body straight as you fall forward.

steps: Kneel holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Push your hips forward and throw the ball far.
Catch yourself with your hands.
Reset.
Stand in a half squat holding a medicine ball.
Step forward and pull the ball to your chest.
Push the ball forward hard.
Run a few steps after it.
Kneel beside an exercise ball.
Rest one elbow on top of the ball, arm out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Hold, then switch sides.
Chest_Stretch_on_Stability_Ball.arms: Elbow on the ball at shoulder height.

steps: Fix a band behind you and hold the handles.
Step forward, arms out to the sides.
Bring your hands together in front.
Open slowly.
Cross_Over_-_With_Bands.breathe: Breathe out as you bring hands together.

steps: Sit on an exercise ball and walk forward until your lower back is on it.
Put your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up.
Lower slowly.
Exercise_Ball_Crunch.back: Lower back rests on the ball.

steps: Start in a push-up with your shins on an exercise ball.
Pull your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball in.
Push your legs back out.
Keep your hips level.
Exercise_Ball_Pull-In.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Bend the leg on the same side.
Press the kettlebell straight up.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
Fix a band at elbow height and stand side-on.
Hold it with the far hand, elbow bent at your side.
Rotate your forearm out, away from your body.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
External_Rotation_with_Band.arms: Elbow stays tucked at your side.
External_Rotation_with_Band.breathe: Breathe out as you rotate out.
External_Rotation_with_Band.mistake: Elbow drifting away from your side.

steps: Sit with a foam roller under the back of your thighs.
Lift your hips with your hands.
Roll slowly from knee to hip.
Pause on tight spots.
Hamstring-SMR.hands: Hands behind you support your weight.

steps: Fix a band low and loop it around one ankle.
Face the post and hold on.
Push that leg straight back.
Return slowly. Switch legs.
Hip_Extension_with_Bands.breathe: Breathe out as you push back.

steps: Fix a band low and loop it around one ankle.
Face away from the post.
Lift that knee up in front.
Lower slowly. Switch legs.
Hip_Flexion_with_Band.legs: Lift the knee to hip height.

steps: Sit on the floor with an exercise ball between your legs.
Hug the ball with your arms.
Lean into it and let your hips sink.
Hold and relax.
Fix a band at elbow height and stand side-on.
Hold it with the near hand, elbow bent at your side.
Rotate your forearm in across your body.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Internal_Rotation_with_Band.breathe: Breathe out as you rotate in.

steps: Stand wide holding a kettlebell with both hands.
Swing it up to one side, turning your body.
Swing it down and up to the other side.
Keep it smooth.
Stand on a band holding the handles at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Lateral_Raise_-_With_Bands.hands: Palms face down at the top.

steps: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your armpit area.
Stretch that arm overhead.
Roll slowly along the side of your back.
Switch sides.
Latissimus_Dorsi-SMR.legs: Use your legs to control the pressure.

steps: Sit with a foam roller under your lower back.
Cross your arms in front.
Lift your hips and roll slowly.
Keep it gentle.
Lower_Back-SMR.back: Roll gently; stop if it hurts.
Lower_Back-SMR.mistake: Pressing hard on a sore back.

steps: Face a partner or wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Push the ball forward hard.
Catch it as it comes back.
Repeat.
Medicine_Ball_Chest_Pass.hands: Both hands on the ball, thumbs behind.

steps: Stand back to back with a partner, holding a medicine ball.
Turn and pass the ball to your partner.
Turn the other way to receive it.
Keep passing.
Medicine_Ball_Full_Twist.arms: Hold the ball in front of you.

steps: Squat holding a medicine ball near your feet.
Drive up with your legs.
Scoop the ball up and throw it high.
Let it land, then repeat.
Stand with a medicine ball in one hand.
Lift it overhead.
Slam it down to the floor beside your front foot.
Pick it up. Switch arms after your set.
One-Arm_Medicine_Ball_Slam.arms: Arm reaches up, then slams down.
One-Arm_Medicine_Ball_Slam.back: Bend at the hips to pick up.
One-Arm_Medicine_Ball_Slam.mistake: Using a ball that bounces back hard.

steps: Stand holding a medicine ball.
Lift it overhead.
Slam it to the floor in front of you.
Pick it up and repeat.
Overhead_Slam.legs: Feet shoulder-width; bend knees to pick up.
Overhead_Slam.mistake: Rounding your back to pick it up.

steps: Rest your upper back on an exercise ball.
Feet flat on the floor.
Lift your hips until level.
Lower slowly.
Physioball_Hip_Bridge.hands: Hands on your hips or chest.

steps: Lie face down over an exercise ball, hips on top.
Rest your hands and feet on the floor.
Relax and let your body hang over the ball.
Hold.
Pyramid.back: Let your back round over the ball.

steps: Stand in a ready stance facing a partner.
Catch the medicine ball they pass you.
Push it straight back.
Reset.
Stand on a band, handles at your shoulders.
Press your hands up overhead.
Lower slowly.
Repeat.
Fix a band low and hold it behind your head.
Elbows point up.
Straighten your arms quickly.
Bend back with control.
Stand holding a medicine ball.
Reach it behind your head.
Throw it forward hard.
Reset.
Lie on your back, knees bent, ball on your chest.
Throw the ball straight up.
Catch it.
Repeat.
Lie on your back, knees bent.
Hold a medicine ball in one hand behind your head.
Throw it forward.
Switch arms after your set.
Lie on your back, knees bent.
Hold a medicine ball behind your head.
Throw it forward.
Repeat.
Stand holding an exercise ball out in front.
Turn your body to one side.
Turn to the other side.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Torso_Rotation.hands: Hold the ball with both hands.

steps: Stand on a band, handles in front of your thighs.
Pull the handles straight up.
Stop at chest height.
Lower slowly.
Upright_Row_-_With_Bands.mistake: Pulling too high if it pinches.

steps: Stand between two low cables, handles at your shoulders.
Press one handle up overhead.
Lower it, then press the other.
Keep switching.
Lie face down on an incline bench.
Hold a light bar near your chest, palms down.
Press the bar straight out past your head.
Bring it back slowly.
Anti-Gravity_Press.arms: Arms stay level as you press out.

steps: Hold the sled straps with arms straight.
Lean back and sit into a half squat.
Walk backward with short steps.
Keep tension on the straps.
Backward_Drag.legs: Knees bent; push through your heels.

steps: Place a balance board on a flat floor near a wall.
Step on with feet apart.
Find your balance and hold.
Step off carefully.
Balance_Board.hands: Arms out or near a wall for safety.

steps: Loop a band over the pull-up bar.
Put one knee or foot in the band.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly.
Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.hands: Palms face away, a bit wider than shoulders.
Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.legs: One knee or foot in the band.
Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.
Band_Assisted_Pull-Up.mistake: Letting the band bounce you up.

steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, arms hanging with a bar.
Curl the bar up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Lie on an incline bench holding a bar straight up.
Keep your arms straight.
Push the bar up by lifting your shoulder blades.
Lower your shoulders back.
Barbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.

steps: Hold a barbell with a wide grip.
Bend forward with a flat back.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows out.
Lower slowly.
Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a block.
Rest a padded bar on your thighs near your knees.
Push up onto your toes.
Lower slowly.
Barbell_Seated_Calf_Raise.legs: Knees bent at about a right angle.
Barbell_Seated_Calf_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.

steps: Hold a barbell behind your thighs.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Rest a light bar across your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width.
Bend sideways at your waist.
Come back up and bend the other way.
Barbell_Side_Bend.back: Bend straight to the side, not forward.
Barbell_Side_Bend.breathe: Breathe out as you come up.

steps: Rest a bar across your upper back, feet wide.
Turn your lead foot out.
Bend that knee and lower toward that side.
Push back up.
Barbell_Side_Split_Squat.legs: Lead knee follows your toes; other leg nearly straight.
Barbell_Side_Split_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Rest a bar across your upper back.
Step forward and lower your back knee.
Push up and step into the next lunge.
Keep walking.
Barbell_Walking_Lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Attach a sled to a belt or harness behind you.
Get on hands and feet, knees low.
Crawl forward, pulling the sled.
Keep your hips low.
Stand with one foot on a bench.
Push off the top foot and switch feet in the air.
Land with the other foot on the bench.
Keep switching quickly.
Hold a low cable handle in one hand.
Bend forward until nearly level.
Raise your arm out to the side.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
Wedge one end of a barbell in a corner.
Stand beside the loaded end and bend forward.
Pull the bar up with one hand.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
Lie back over a Bosu ball between two low cables.
Hold a handle in each hand by your head.
Crunch up, then bend to one side.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Bosu_Ball_Cable_Crunch_With_Side_Bends.back: Lower back curves over the ball.

steps: Stand facing a low box.
Swing your arms and jump onto it.
Step or hop down.
Repeat.
Line up low boxes a few steps apart.
Drive off your back leg onto the first box.
Push off and leap to the floor between boxes.
Keep going down the line.
Sit with a barbell at the front of your shoulders.
Press it just over your head.
Lower it behind your head, then press up again.
Lower to the front. Repeat.
Bradford_Rocky_Presses.arms: Arms go just high enough to clear your head.
Bradford_Rocky_Presses.mistake: Using heavy weight behind the neck.

steps: Sit in the cable press with handles at chest height.
Push the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Repeat.
Cable_Chest_Press.arms: Elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

steps: Stand between two low cables.
Squat down and grab the handles.
Stand up tall with a flat back.
Lower the same way.
Lie on an incline bench facing away from a high cable.
Hold the bar overhead, arms straight up.
Push the bar down to your thighs, arms straight.
Return slowly.
Lie on an incline bench facing away from a high cable.
Hold the bar above your head, elbows bent.
Straighten your arms forward.
Bend back slowly.
Sit side-on to a low cable.
Hold the handle with the near arm, elbow bent at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your body.
Return slowly.
Cable_Internal_Rotation.breathe: Breathe out as you rotate in.

steps: Stand between two high cables, arms out in a T.
Pull your straight arms down to your sides.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Cable_Iron_Cross.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down.

steps: Stand side-on to a low cable, holding a rope.
Twist away and pull the rope over your shoulder.
Crunch forward as you pull down.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Lie on a bench holding a low-cable bar over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep upper arms still.
Hold a high-cable handle in one hand, palm up.
Elbow at your side.
Push down until your arm is straight.
Return slowly. Switch arms.
Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the bar up.
Lower slowly.
Lie with your feet toward a low cable, strap on your ankles.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up toward your chest.
Lower slowly.
Sit at a low row with a rope, palms down.
Pull the rope toward your neck, elbows high.
Squeeze your upper back.
Return slowly.
Lie with your upper back on a ball, side-on to a cable.
Hold the handle with both arms straight up.
Turn your body away from the cable.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Sit with your back to a high cable, rope by your head.
Curl your body forward and down.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Cable_Seated_Crunch.hands: Hold the rope beside your head.
Cable_Seated_Crunch.back: Round your back as you curl.

steps: Sit on a bench between two low cables, leaning forward.
Hold the handles crossed under your legs.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.
Stand between two low cables, handles at your shoulders.
Press both handles up overhead.
Lower slowly.
Repeat.
Hold a low-cable bar in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Sit facing a low cable with forearms on your thighs.
Hold the bar with palms up.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.
Stand in the calf machine with the pads on your shoulders.
Lift your shoulders up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Hold a weight plate out in front at shoulder height.
Turn it like a steering wheel to one side.
Turn it to the other side.
Keep your arms straight.
Car_Drivers.hands: Hold the plate at 3 and 9 o'clock.

steps: Sit tall and hold the sides of the chair.
Straighten one leg and pull your toes up.
Slowly move that leg out to the side.
Bring it back. Switch legs.
Rest a bar across your upper back.
Step your feet forward a little.
Sit back as if into a chair.
Stand back up.
Chair_Squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Sit on the edge of a chair and hold the back of it behind you.
Straighten your arms.
Lean your chest forward.
Hold the stretch.
Hold a broomstick in front with a wide grip.
Lift it up overhead.
Slowly take it back behind you as far as is comfy.
Hold, then return.
Stand with the bar over your feet.
Grip it just outside your knees.
Push through your legs and stand up, bar close.
Lower the same way.
Clean_Deadlift.mistake: Bar drifting away from your legs.

steps: Hold the bar at mid-thigh, leaning slightly forward.
Stand up fast and shrug your shoulders.
Rise onto your toes.
Lower and reset.
Attach a band to each end of an EZ bar and stand on it.
Hold the bar with a narrow grip.
Curl it up.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar with a narrow grip.
Lower it to your lower chest.
Press it back up.
Keep elbows tucked.
Stand holding an EZ bar on the inner grips.
Curl it up toward your shoulders.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Hold a barbell with hands a few inches apart.
Curl it up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Hold a weight in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Hold them at shoulder height.
Lower when you can no longer hold.
Crucifix.arms: Arms straight out to the sides.

steps: Lie on a decline bench holding an EZ bar over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower it toward your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep upper arms still.
Set a decline bench under the Smith bar.
Unhook the bar.
Lower it to your lower chest.
Press it back up.
Stand on a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Jump right away onto the next box.
Step down and reset.
Sit in the dip machine and grip the handles.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep elbows in.
Set a cable at elbow height and stand side-on.
Hold it with the far hand, elbow bent at your side.
Rotate your forearm away from your body.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
External_Rotation_with_Cable.breathe: Breathe out as you rotate out.

steps: Sit with forearms on your thighs, holding a bar palms up.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers to roll it back up.
Repeat.
Finger_Curls.hands: Palms up; fingers do the work.

steps: Stand in front of a box.
Dip and swing your arms.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Step down.
Set small cones in a row.
Stand in front of the first one.
Hop over each cone with both feet.
Land softly each time.
Lie on a bench with a bar on your thighs.
Raise it in an arc over your chest.
Keep going until it is behind your head.
Reverse back to your thighs.
Front_Raise_And_Pullover.breathe: Breathe in as the bar goes back.

steps: Stand next to a heavy bag, hand on it.
Twist and push the bag away hard.
Catch it as it swings back.
Repeat.
Set small hurdles in a row.
Stand in front of the first.
Hop over each with both feet.
Land softly.
Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Pull the weights up to your sides.
Lower slowly.
Sit in an incline cable press.
Hold the handles at your upper chest.
Push forward and up.
Return slowly.
Put your feet on a box and hands between two mats.
Lower your chest.
Push up hard and land hands on the mats.
Push back to the middle.
Hang suspension straps from a sturdy anchor.
Hold the handles and lean back, body straight.
Pull your chest up to your hands.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a bench holding a bar with a close grip.
Lower the bar toward your chin, elbows forward.
Press back up.
Keep it controlled.
Start the treadmill at a walk.
Speed up to an easy jog.
Keep a pace you can talk at.
Slow to a walk at the end.
Kneel below a high cable holding a rope by your head.
Crunch down and twist to one side.
Return up.
Crunch and twist to the other side.
Kneeling_Cable_Crunch_With_Alternating_O.back: Round your back as you crunch.

steps: Kneel in front of a high cable holding a rope.
Pull the rope to your upper chest, elbows out.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Kneel facing a high cable with one handle.
Pull it down to your side.
Pause.
Return slowly. Switch arms.
Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height, arms straight.
Stand wide.
Rotate and swing the bar down to one side.
Swing it over to the other side.
Landmine_180s.hands: Both hands on the bar end.
Landmine_180s.back: Turn from your hips and middle.

steps: Stand beside a low box.
Dip and jump sideways onto it.
Land softly.
Step down and repeat.
Set cones in a row.
Stand side-on to them.
Hop sideways over each cone.
Land softly.
Stand between the machine handles.
Squat down and grab them.
Stand up tall.
Lower slowly.
Sit in the machine with handles at your lower chest.
Press forward and down.
Return slowly.
Repeat.
Sit with your knees under the pad.
Reach up and grab the handles.
Pull them down to your chest.
Return slowly.
Sit with handles at your upper chest.
Press up and forward.
Return slowly.
Repeat.
Sit with your chest on the pad.
Hold the handles.
Pull them back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Stand between the handles and grip them.
Stand up tall.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Lower slowly.
Set both cables low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward.
Bring your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Lower slowly.
Low_Cable_Crossover.breathe: Breathe out as you bring hands together.

steps: Lie on a row bench, head toward a low cable rope.
Hold the rope above your head, elbows bent.
Straighten your arms up.
Bend slowly back.
Low_Cable_Triceps_Extension.legs: Feet on the bench or floor.

steps: Sit at a low row with a rope, palms down.
Lift your elbows and pull the rope to your neck.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Low_Pulley_Row_To_Neck.arms: Elbows high, out to the sides.

steps: Lie face down on a raised bench with a cambered bar below.
Grab the bar wider than your shoulders.
Pull it up toward the bench.
Lower slowly.
Lie on a bench under a high cable.
Hold the bar with palms up, arms straight up.
Curl the bar toward your forehead.
Straighten slowly.
Sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the handles.
Curl them up.
Lower slowly.
Sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the handles with elbows bent.
Straighten your arms.
Return slowly.
Lie on a bench with one leg over the side.
Bend that knee and hold the top of your foot.
Gently pull your heel toward your bottom.
Hold, then switch.
On-Your-Back_Quad_Stretch.hands: Hold the top of your foot.
On-Your-Back_Quad_Stretch.back: Do not arch your lower back.

steps: Stand side-on to a high cable, handle overhead.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return slowly.
Switch sides after your set.
Wedge a barbell in a landmine or corner.
Stand beside the loaded end and bend forward.
Pull the bar up with one hand.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
Sit at a pulldown with one handle.
Pull it down to your shoulder.
Pause.
Return slowly. Switch arms.
One_Arm_Lat_Pulldown.arms: Elbow pulls down to your side.

steps: Grab a bar with one hand, feet still on the floor.
Let most of your weight hang from that hand.
Relax and feel the stretch.
Switch hands.
One_Handed_Hang.legs: Feet on the floor or a step.

steps: Lie with knees bent and feet held, a weight on your chest.
Sit up.
Press the weight overhead at the top.
Bring it back to your chest as you lower.
Otis-Up.arms: Press straight up at the top.
Otis-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you sit up.

steps: Stand side-on to a chest-height cable.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press out, then turn slightly away from the cable.
Return. Switch sides.
Kneel and rest your forearms on a bench.
Hold a barbell, palms down, wrists over the edge.
Lift the backs of your hands.
Lower slowly.
Hop up on parallel bars, arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up.
Keep it controlled.
Lie on a smooth floor with a towel under one heel.
Slide that heel toward your bottom.
Slide it back out.
Switch legs.
Platform_Hamstring_Slides.breathe: Breathe out as you slide in.

steps: Sit at a preacher bench with an EZ bar.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the bar up.
Lower slowly until arms are nearly straight.
Load the sled lightly.
Grip the handles and lean in.
Drive forward with short, fast steps.
Rest and repeat.
Prowler_Sprint.back: Body leans in a straight line.

steps: Stand facing a low box.
Hop onto it with both feet.
Step down.
Repeat quickly.
Sit and adjust the seat so your leg is almost straight.
Start pedaling easily.
Keep a steady pace.
Ease off at the end.
Recumbent_Bike.legs: Knees in line with your feet.

steps: Stand facing a low cable with a bar.
Hold it palms down.
Curl it up.
Lower slowly.
Face a high cable and grip the bar palms up.
Elbows at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Hold a weight plate in front, palms down.
Curl it up toward your chest.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Reverse_Plate_Curls.hands: Palms down, fingers on the rim.

steps: Rest a bar across your upper back.
Rise up onto your toes.
Lower and rock back onto your heels, toes up.
Repeat.
Kneel in front of a cable with a rope overhead.
Hold the rope by your head.
Curl down toward the floor.
Return slowly.
Rope_Crunch.back: Round your back as you crunch.

steps: Face a high cable with a rope.
Step back and lean forward a little.
Pull the rope down to your thighs, arms straight.
Return slowly.
Hold a broomstick behind your hips with a wide grip.
Lift it slowly up behind you.
Go only as far as is comfy.
Lower slowly.
Squat and hug the sandbag to your chest.
Stand up and carry it to the platform.
Lift it onto the platform.
Go back for the next one.
Sandbag_Load.back: Keep your back as flat as you can.

steps: Sit on a bench with a band behind your ankles.
Legs start straight out in front.
Pull your heels back under the bench.
Return slowly.
Seated_Band_Hamstring_Curl.legs: Bend your knees against the band.

steps: Sit on a bench with an empty bar across your shoulders.
Turn your upper body to one side.
Turn to the other side.
Keep your hips still.
Sit in the cable press with handles at your shoulders.
Press up.
Lower slowly.
Repeat.
Sit with forearms on your thighs, holding a bar palms down.
Lift the backs of your hands.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Sit facing a low cable with forearms on your thighs.
Hold the bar palms up.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.
Stand in a wide split stance holding a low cable handle.
Pull it back to your side, turning your palm up.
Pause.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Shotgun_Row.hands: Palm turns up as you pull.

steps: Stand beside a cone.
Hop sideways over it and back a few times.
Then sprint forward a short way.
Walk back and repeat.
Stand beside a low box with one foot on it.
Jump over to the other side, switching feet.
Land with the other foot on the box.
Keep shuffling.
Stand side-on to a high cable, handle in the near hand.
Pull it down and across your body.
Pause.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Single-Arm_Cable_Crossover.breathe: Breathe out as you pull across.

steps: Stand beside a cone.
Move your feet as fast as you can.
Sprint around the cone.
Walk back and repeat.
Stand on one leg in front of a row of cones.
Hop forward over each cone.
Land softly on the same leg.
Switch legs.
Stand on one leg beside a cone.
Hop sideways over it.
Land softly, then hop back.
Switch legs.
Sit in the leg extension machine.
Put one leg under the pad.
Straighten that leg.
Lower slowly. Switch legs.
Single-Leg_Leg_Extension.legs: Knee lines up with the pivot.

steps: Stand beside a box with your inside foot on it.
Push through that foot and jump up.
Drive the other knee up.
Land back in the same spot.
Stand with one foot on a box.
Push off the top foot as high as you can.
Land with the same foot back on the box.
Repeat, then switch.
Attach a sled to a harness or belt.
Lean forward.
Walk or run forward, pulling the sled.
Rest and repeat.
Sled_Drag_-_Harness.back: Lean forward with a flat back.

steps: Face the sled holding the handles overhead.
Back up until the line is tight.
Walk backward with your arms up.
Keep it smooth.
Face away from the sled holding handles behind your head.
Step forward until the line is tight.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Bend back slowly and step forward.
Grip the sled handles with arms straight.
Lean in.
Push the sled forward with strong steps.
Rest and repeat.
Sled_Push.legs: Drive through the balls of your feet.
Sled_Push.back: Body leans in a straight line.

steps: Face the sled holding the handles in front.
Back up until the line is tight.
Pull your arms out to the sides.
Step back and repeat.
Face the sled holding the handles.
Back up until the line is tight.
Row the handles to your sides.
Step back and repeat.
Stand in front of a tire holding a sledgehammer.
Lift the hammer over your shoulder.
Swing it down onto the tire.
Switch sides every few swings.
Sledgehammer_Swings.hands: Slide your top hand down as you swing.
Sledgehammer_Swings.legs: Bend your knees as you strike.

steps: Lie on an incline bench under the Smith bar.
Hold the bar with arms straight.
Push it up by lifting your shoulder blades.
Lower your shoulders back.
Stand with the Smith bar behind your thighs.
Grip it and unhook it.
Lift your shoulders up.
Lower slowly.
Set the Smith bar just below your knees.
Bend forward and grip it.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower slowly.
Stand on a block under the Smith bar.
Rest the bar across your upper back.
Rise onto your toes.
Lower slowly.
Lie under the Smith bar.
Grip it about shoulder-width.
Lower to your lower chest.
Press back up.
Set a decline bench under the Smith bar.
Unhook the bar.
Lower it to your lower chest.
Press up.
Lie on a bench with your feet pressing up on the Smith bar.
Unlock the bar with legs nearly straight.
Curl your hips up off the bench.
Lower slowly.
Set an incline bench under the Smith bar.
Unhook the bar.
Lower it to your upper chest.
Press up.
Stand at a Smith bar at thigh height.
Hold it with one hand.
Pull it straight up to chest height.
Lower slowly. Switch arms.
Sit under the Smith bar, bar at your shoulders.
Unhook it.
Press it up.
Lower slowly.
Stand on a platform with your heels on it, toes off.
Rest the Smith bar on your shoulders.
Lift your toes up.
Lower slowly.
Stand at a Smith bar at mid-thigh.
Grip it a bit narrower than shoulders.
Pull it up to chest height.
Lower slowly.
Smith_Machine_Upright_Row.mistake: Pulling too high if it pinches.

steps: Rest a bar across your upper back.
Rise onto your toes.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and turn palms down.
Lift your arms gently.
Hold.
Standing_Biceps_Stretch.back: Stand tall; do not lean forward.

steps: Hold a bar at the front of your shoulders.
Press it just over your head.
Lower it behind your head.
Press up and return to the front.
Standing_Bradford_Press.arms: Arms go just high enough to clear your head.
Standing_Bradford_Press.mistake: Using heavy weight behind the neck.

steps: Stand between two chest-height cables.
Hold a handle in each hand.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Standing_Cable_Chest_Press.arms: Elbows a little below your shoulders.

steps: Stand side-on to a low cable.
Hold the handle with both hands near your hip.
Pull it up and across your body.
Return slowly. Switch sides.
Stand with your back to a bench.
Rest one foot on the bench behind you.
Bend your standing knee a little.
Hold, then switch.
Standing_Elevated_Quad_Stretch.hands: Hands on hips or a wall.

steps: Loop a band around one foot and put that foot forward.
Bend your back knee.
Pull the band to lift your toes.
Hold, then switch.
Stand in the machine with the pad behind one ankle.
Hold the handles.
Curl your heel up.
Lower slowly. Switch legs.
Stand side-on to a low cable, handle in the far hand.
Raise your arm out to shoulder height.
Pause.
Lower slowly. Switch sides.
Hold a weight plate by the rim in each hand.
Let the plates slide down toward your fingertips.
Squeeze them back up into your hands.
Repeat.
Standing_Olympic_Plate_Hand_Squeeze.mistake: Dropping a plate on your feet.

steps: Hold a bar overhead with a close grip.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep elbows close.
Hold a bar behind your thighs.
Curl your wrists up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Stand with your back to a high cable, rope over your shoulders.
Crunch your body forward and down.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Standing_Rope_Crunch.hands: Hold the rope by your shoulders.
Standing_Rope_Crunch.back: Round your back as you crunch.

steps: Rest a light bar across your upper back.
Keep your legs nearly straight.
Push your hips back and lean forward.
Stand back up.
Stand on a bench behind a loaded bar.
Hinge forward and grip the bar.
Row it to your middle.
Lower all the way down.
Lie face down on an incline bench with a light bar.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the bar up in front of you.
Lower slowly.
Stand beside a box with your inside foot on it.
Jump up and across to the other side.
Land with the other foot on the box.
Keep crossing.
Hold suspension strap handles in a push-up position.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Push back up.
Keep the straps steady.
Suspended_Push-Up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Put your feet in suspension straps and get into a push-up position.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Push your legs back out.
Keep your hips level.
Suspended_Reverse_Crunch.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.

steps: Hold suspension straps at chest height.
Lean back with arms straight.
Pull your chest to your hands.
Lower slowly.
Press two light plates together at your chest.
Push them straight out in front.
Keep squeezing them together.
Bring them back.
Wedge a bar in a landmine and attach a row handle.
Stand over it and bend forward.
Pull the handle to your chest.
Lower slowly.
Face a high cable with a V-bar.
Elbows at your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Sit at a pulldown with thighs under the pad.
Grip the bar palms facing you.
Pull it to your upper chest.
Return slowly.
Hold a barbell with a wide grip.
Curl it up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
Hold a wrist roller out in front, palms down.
Turn your wrists to roll the weight up.
Then roll it slowly back down.
Keep your arms up.
Wrist_Roller.hands: Palms down; wrists do the work.
Wrist_Roller.arms: Arms straight out at shoulder height.

steps: Hold a light bar in front, palms down.
Roll your wrists one at a time, like wringing a towel.
Then roll the other way.
Keep it slow.
Stand with feet a bit wider than hips, kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at your hips and swing it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it swing back down. Switch hands after your set.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.hands: Firm grip on the handle; free hand out for balance.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.arms: Swinging arm stays straight and loose.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.breathe: Breathe out as the bell swings up.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings.mistake: Lifting with your arm instead of your hips.
